hook: Your whole town gets moved if the ground below it is worth more.
title: A Whole Swedish Town Is Being Moved
description:
Kiruna in northern Sweden sits on a huge iron ore mine, and the ground under the town centre is becoming unstable. So the town is being relocated, including its church. Part of the series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Kiruna #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you move? Yes or no
